summary: RTS controls on the 2D expedition route board: the drawn portal lines, the teal midpoint dots and the route legend are deleted, tiles are isometric glyphs that tint by reachability, left-click selects or inspects, right-click orders the move, and the route words and digits 1-9 issue the same order through the one request_travel path.

coordination.notes: P7 is B18 resumed; the stopped B18 lane pushed a claim and no code, so this claim replaces it rather than joining it. Branched from origin/backend/b0-expedition-state at f5d26d1. Godot-only lane: no Rust, no port, no campaign_session.gd, no content, no docs/SHIP_PLAN.md. draw_portal and its midpoint dot are deleted rather than hidden -- move 3, the feature goes -- and the reachability those lines carried becomes the tint on the tile, which is the same snapshot fact drawn once instead of twice. Legality stays where it is: the native legal_route_commands list is the only judge, and portal_from_active_cell_to is a lookup inside that list, not a second check. The board owns the cell-to-portal mapping because it already builds the catalog portal list; the prototype asks it rather than keeping a second copy. request_travel remains the single path to the bridge -- the words, the right-click and the hotkey all end in it -- and the mouse and key handlers call the same three hooks a suite calls, so there is one code path per order and not two. Reduced motion is read from SettingsPanel's own SETTINGS_PATH and SECTION constants rather than copied, and no file under game/scripts/ui/ is edited. P4 is building the 3D board in parallel and will adopt these controls through the same three functions.
